description: Set the multiplicative factor for stiffnesses to be added to zones. By default the factor is 1.

examples.description: Scale the stiffness added to the zones

notes: The 6.0 manual documents this command too, but the 6.00 binaries have no coupling commands at all (live top-level command enumeration on the PFC3D 6.00 GUI).
verification: Live-verified 2026-11-09 on PFC2D and PFC3D 7.00 and 9.8 consoles (plus the PFC3D 6.00 GUI for the 6.0 verdict) (syntax grade): accepted (f >= 0) on 2D and 3D, 7.00 and 9.8.
